body:
## What it does

The hardest part of making a bot is describing what you want it to do. This one sits with a beginner, asks the questions that surface the real job, and produces a single clear brief they can then take away and use to create the bot themselves. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @anandVragav shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
